lead_org_at_most_one.name: lead_org_at_most_one
lead_org_at_most_one.value: NOT ("activities"."lead_org_id" IS NOT NULL AND "activities"."lead_org_name" IS NOT NULL)

asf_scope_team_scope_check.name: asf_scope_team_scope_check
asf_scope_team_scope_check.value:
(
        ("activity_saved_filters"."scope_type" = 'team' AND "activity_saved_filters"."scope_team_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("activity_saved_filters"."scope_type" IN ('user', 'global') AND "activity_saved_filters"."scope_team_id" IS NULL)
      )
